headline: Weathered Expanse Works Fall at Last; Fishermans Row Rages On
war_summary: The latest edition brings a shift long withheld: two works in the Weathered Expanse, Foxcatcher and Necropolis, have gone over to Colonial hands, the newest entry logged scarce a minute before press, even as that field's dreadful casualty ledger cools from its peak — above twenty-two thousand Colonial and twenty-five thousand Warden losses in the day. Fishermans Row remains the busiest base front, thirty actions in twenty-four hours and seven in the last two, Fort Ember again the pivot, with losses re-accelerating toward five hundred Warden and nearly three hundred Colonial in two hours. In the Dead Lands, The Salt March passed through ruin into Warden hands late last evening, while losses there climb past ten and fourteen thousand and still quicken. Lykos Isle keeps its new briskness — twelve actions in the day, the newest before three o'clock. Farranac Coast has moved no base since the small hours, yet bleeds hard, above six thousand apiece, its rates rising; Stlican Shelf, wholly Warden, takes a heavy Colonial casualty surge. Tempest Island and Godcrofts have been quiet since morning. The ledger reads two hundred forty-six Colonial works to one hundred eighty-eight Warden, a net shift toward the Colonial column. It is the war's hundred-and-nineteenth day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
